df7cb left a comment (postgis/h3-pg#206)

Fwiw I just tried shoveling all h3 .h files into libh3-dev and making h3-pg use -I/usr/include/h3 so we don't need that h3/ prefix in all #include <xx.h> calls. The patch for that is this:

Index: h3-pg/CMakeLists.txt
===================================================================
--- h3-pg.orig/CMakeLists.txt   2026-06-17 16:43:55.926341376 +0200
+++ h3-pg/CMakeLists.txt        2026-06-17 16:52:28.265284010 +0200
@@ -59,9 +59,6 @@ if(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL PROJECT_N
   include(CTest)
 endif()
 
-# Include core library
-add_subdirectory(cmake/h3)
-
 # Include extensions and their shared code
 add_subdirectory(include)
 add_subdirectory(h3)
Index: h3-pg/h3/CMakeLists.txt
===================================================================
--- h3-pg.orig/h3/CMakeLists.txt        2026-06-17 16:43:55.926341376 +0200
+++ h3-pg/h3/CMakeLists.txt     2026-06-17 16:51:31.402853600 +0200
@@ -93,6 +93,7 @@ configure_file(src/config.h.in src/confi
 target_include_directories(postgresql_h3 PRIVATE
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/src
   src
+  /usr/include/h3
 )
 
 # link
Index: h3-pg/h3_postgis/CMakeLists.txt
===================================================================
--- h3-pg.orig/h3_postgis/CMakeLists.txt        2026-06-08 03:55:17.000000000 +0200
+++ h3-pg/h3_postgis/CMakeLists.txt     2026-06-17 16:50:51.992554510 +0200
@@ -46,7 +46,7 @@ PostgreSQL_add_extension(postgresql_h3_p
 
 # link
 target_link_libraries(postgresql_h3_postgis PRIVATE postgresql_h3_shared h3)
-target_include_directories(postgresql_h3_postgis PRIVATE ${H3_INTERNAL_INCLUDE_DIR})
+target_include_directories(postgresql_h3_postgis PRIVATE /usr/include/h3)
 
 # Emit PostgreSQL JIT bitcode only after all include/link settings are final.
 PostgreSQL_add_extension_bitcode(postgresql_h3_postgis h3_postgis ${PROJECT_NAME})
Index: h3-pg/include/CMakeLists.txt
===================================================================
--- h3-pg.orig/include/CMakeLists.txt   2026-06-08 03:55:17.000000000 +0200
+++ h3-pg/include/CMakeLists.txt        2026-06-17 16:50:30.670392418 +0200
@@ -6,6 +6,6 @@ target_link_libraries(postgresql_h3_shar
 )
 target_include_directories(postgresql_h3_shared
   INTERFACE ./
-  PRIVATE ${H3_INCLUDE_DIR}
+  PRIVATE /usr/include/h3
 )
 set_target_properties(postgresql_h3_shared PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE True)
